versions.changelog: Security remediation: remove bundled billing and secrets, declare read-only permissions, add financial-risk warnings, and align the implementation with its read-only market-scanning behavior.

- Added support for SkillPay billing system (optional): users must pay before accessing, non-paying users are given a payment link, and developers receive 95% of revenue.
- Updated documentation to reflect billing option and provide configuration examples for SkillPay.
- General improvements to usage instructions and feature descriptions.
